model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the “Per-specialty terms”, with categories labeled “Cardio”, “Gastro”, “Infect”, “Neuro”, “Obstetrics”, and “Pediatrics” displayed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27 with tick marks at integer values. Each specialty has a set of six grouped bars, one for each fine-tuning dataset (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), each colored a shade of orange except for the bars corresponding to the fine-tuning specialty, which are blue. Within each specialty group, the bars exhibit comparatively similar lengths with minor variations, typically between -22.5 and -26.5; for instance, in the “Cardio” specialty, the bars all fall within this range, and in “Pediatrics”, the bars range from approximately -23 to -26. The bars are arranged in groups by specialty, and no particular sorting order is apparent within these groups, and no bars are visually emphasized.
